description: Agent Childcare Records: submit childcare staff records, the facility’s staff qualification file, with the qualification requirements and the ratio record placements they answer to: the reading moment; each qualification the staff record requires by role with its id, reference, the role (such as director or lead teacher) and the qualification, training entries included; each staff entry with its id, reference, role and hire date; each qualification or training entry with its id, reference, the staff member, the qualification and the moment it lapses; each placement the childcare ratio record names with its id, reference, the staff member, the room and the day relied on. The signed report gives the staff and the records behind them, each staff entry for its role and hire date, each staff member against the qualifications the record requires for the role, each qualification against the days the ratio record relies on the staff member, and each staff member the ratio record names against the staff record, and counts them, and names divergent childcare staff records: a staff entry missing the role or the hire date, a staff member missing a qualification the record requires, a qualification expired on a day the ratio record relies on, and a staff member the ratio record names that the staff record does not identify; then a qualification entry naming a staff member the record does not hold and a placement dated before the hire date, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No staff entries, or no requirements beside staff, leaves those points unverified. Staff members and placements match by letters and digits, roles and qualifications by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, and a qualification is current through the day it lapses. Adult paper only: roles, dates and qualification status from the licensing qualification file, with training entries read as part of it; this check reads no background check and runs none. Verdict childcare_staff_record_divergent, childcare_staff_record_partial, childcare_staff_record_unverified or childcare_staff_record_consistent. POST /api/childcare-staff-record-check. Reads the childcare records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no childcare facility, contacts no licensing agency or parent, runs no background check on anyone and issues no license, credential or certification, which stay with the operator and the licensing agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Childcare Records reads licensed childcare facility and staff compliance records, for childcare centers and family childcare homes, and never a record about an individual child: health records belong to Agent Healthcare, education records belong to Agent Education, food-safety records belong to Agent Food Safety Records, staff checks read the licensing qualification file and never run background checks, and pet daycare is not childcare (Agent Veterinary Records reads animal records). It reads a childcare operator’s own compliance paper: the childcare facility record with its license and license conditions, the licensing agency’s childcare inspection record, the childcare staff record with training entries, each childcare credential as issued, the childcare enrollment record and the childcare ratio record as counts, the childcare incident record from its date, type, notification and filing fields, and the childcare safety record with the emergency plan, each against the inspection, enrollment, condition, schedule, violation, requirement, qualification, placement, reliance, capacity, staffing, notification, drill and corrective action records it answers to. The family’s ground is the childcare facility’s paper trail: what the facility record and its license claim, whether the inspections hold up, what the staff and credential records support, what the enrollment and ratio counts show, and whether the incident log and the safety record line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-childcare-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-childcare-records/.

assignments.description: Each staff placement the childcare ratio record names in a room.

at.description: The day the ratio record relies on the staff member, such as 2026-03-02.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

qualifications.description: Each qualification or training entry in the staff qualification file.

requirements.description: Each qualification the staff record itself requires by role, training entries included.

qualification.description: The qualification the role requires, such as a director credential or annual training hours.

role.description: The role, such as director or lead teacher.

staff.description: Each staff entry in the childcare staff record: the role and the hire date.
